about: Limits for the RigidBodyPhysics ladder (tools/physics_judge.py), written after one exploration run (27 Nov 2026, see docs/PHYSICS.md) and before the measured runs. Each limit is on Blender's numbers; X_ITE's are recorded next to them and not gated. Analytic answers come from x3d.loom x3d.physics/rigid-engines lib/scenes.js (fc30c89). A limit that a later run needs to change is changed in its own commit, with the reason here.

apex above contact (m), analytic 1.125.why: Blender 5.3's solver drops restitution for slow impacts at small steps (docs/PHYSICS.md, the restitution lottery); kept as a gate that is expected to fail until Blender changes
